purpose: Exploratory explanation of the failed pooled displacement prerequisite; no replacement gate or authorization to train memory models.

data.dev_use: Previously inspected; exploratory reporting only, never hyperparameter or model selection.

methods.concat: Original centered concatenated t6/t7 ridge predicting all eight targets.
methods.difference_hybrid: Centered (t7-t6) ridge predicts four displacement targets; original fixed-alpha 0.01 concat ridge supplies four position predictions.
methods.shared_position: One ridge decoder maps both frames to positions, trained with analysis-only targets p7 and p6=p7-displacement; predicts p7 and derives displacement by subtracting predicted positions.

normalization: Within each fit only: center features on fitting observations and divide Gram matrices by their mean centered diagonal. Shared-position fit pools both frame times.

cv.group: pair_id; both variants and both frames stay together
cv.objective: Mean of four displacement-dimension MSE ratios against that fold's Train target mean evaluated on held-out Train pairs; average equally across folds.

sample_size_sensitivity.alpha_selection: Repeat inner-Train grouped CV separately for each subset; never select a sample size using Dev.

bootstrap.metric: Mean displacement R2; recompute resampled Dev denominator against fixed Train target mean.
bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory paired-sample uncertainty, not a new scientific gate or independent confirmation.

numerics.solver: dual Gram ridge; never a feature-dimensional primal system

invariants: Original feature_gate.json and prior results remain unchanged
No automatic Dev winner or downstream training approval
All fitting/cross-validation choices are fixed before Dev reporting
